text: Ha Tinh attracts $7.6b in investment to industrial and economic zones

Thanks to improved regional connectivity and an open approach to investment attraction, central Ha Tinh province is drawing a growing number of large-scale projects expected to drive the province's economic growth.

Speaking on the sidelines of an investment promotion conference for the expanded Gia Lach Industrial Park (DragonIZ Ha Tinh) on November 14, Mr. Nguyen Hoai Son, head of the Ha Tinh Economic Zone Authority, said nearly VND200 trillion ($7.6 billion) in investment had been attracted to the province's economic and industrial zones since the beginning of the year.
Major projects include infrastructure, logistics, clean energy and steel manufacturing.
Foreign direct investment (FDI) has also gained momentum.
Since the beginning of 2026, the province has licensed seven foreign-invested projects with total registered capital of nearly $506 million.
Recently, Ha Tinh granted an investment certificate to a Hong Kong-based investor for a project worth around VND2.5 trillion ($100 million) at Bac Thach Ha Industrial Park (VSIP).
It is also assisting a Singaporean investor in completing procedures for a project worth approximately $60 million at Phu Vinh Industrial Park.
Despite these encouraging investment results, the key to achieving double-digit economic growth in 2026 will be how quickly projects are put into operation.

According to Mr. Son, the provincial Economic Zone Authority is focusing on resolving two major bottlenecks facing businesses: administrative procedures and site clearance, in order to fulfil the growth target.
